data.name: Hexes
data.description: The following hexes complement the winter witch archetype: beast eye*, blight, cook people*, evil eye, feral speech*, hag's eye, hoarfrost*, ice tomb*, witch's hut.* An asterisk (*) indicates a hex detailed in Ultimate Magic.&nl;A winter witch can select the following hexes: Frostfoot and Frozen Caress.
